description: This Java class `ExternalEventConfigurationUpdateResponse` is a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent the response for external event configuration updates within the Fineract infrastructure. It contains a HashMap to hold change details and uses Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationUpdateResponse
classes.description: A serializable data class representing the response for external event configuration updates, encapsulating change details in a HashMap.
